info.title: Groundplan API
info.description: Real estate planning engine for financial advisors. Every number is a Figure with provenance; money is integer cents; errors are RFC 7807 problem+json. Tenancy: every request (except /health, /meta, /eval/latest) carries `X-Workspace-Id` (a UUID); unknown workspaces are provisioned and seeded with the demo household on first use.
